Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. Procurement asked me to follow up with the current draft PO and a couple of questions so we can close before our renew window on Oct 15. Two items we need to lock down:

Morning all —

On the AWS Marketplace side, quarterly invoicing is supported but there are two common execution patterns:

A) Single private offer published for the full commitment with Revenue Recognition on Redwood's side; Redwood invoices Acme quarterly and absorbs marketplace collection variance.
B) Split PO approach: create two invoices on AWS side (e.g., commit + top-up) so Acme receives distinct invoice lines each quarter. This can simplify your accounting if you need tranche-level GL codes.

For the 15-month bridge, legal typically wants explicit start/end dates and a clause outlining pro-rated credits for the initial overlap period. If Acme can confirm the exact start date (we're assuming Oct 1, 2027), we can template the language.

I'll open a ticket with our AWS marketplace contact and tag them on the thread if you want me to proceed. We will need: signatory name, contact email for DocuSign routing, and any PO reference you require on invoices.

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference
